strings.title: The Café Cipher
strings.hint: The unfinished line on the screen names a code repository… so who cloned it in the early hours? And a fingerprint on the cup of someone who "wasn't there" is as good as a confession.
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: co-founder Nadim Azer.

Dana was going to reject the acquisition that morning and tell the investors that Nadim had leaked the source code to the buyer a month earlier to secure his own share. He met her at the café where she worked at night for "one last attempt to persuade her." When she insisted on exposing him, he strangled her and took the backup drive. But the screen remained open on a line whose significance he had missed: the name of the evidence repository she had prepared against him.

His fingerprint on her coffee cup despite denying his visit, a Git log showing the evidence repository cloned from his device at 01:12, and the leaked messages recovered from the company server proved his guilt.
strings.summary.text: At two in the morning, the closing employee found startup founder Dana Seif motionless at her usual table in Midad Café, where she had built her company night after night. Her laptop was open, her backup drive missing, and an unfinished command on the screen stopped at a mysterious repository name: evidence-nx. The next morning, she was due to sign, or reject, an eight-figure acquisition deal.
strings.summary.photoCap: Her broken phone beside the table
strings.summary.victim.name: Dana Seif
strings.summary.victim.job: Founder of the tech startup Nexa
strings.summary.timeline[0].l: She arrives at the café for her nightly work session
strings.summary.timeline[1].l: A street camera records a visitor entering
strings.summary.timeline[2].l: The evidence repository is cloned from an external device
strings.summary.timeline[3].l: The closing employee discovers the body
strings.scene.address: Midad Café — the back corner, downtown
strings.scene.intro: No money was stolen and there was no disorder. The killer sat opposite his victim and had coffee with her: two cups stood on the table. The computer was accessed after her death, with failed password attempts, and the backup drive was pulled from the bag so hastily that its zipper tore.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: The smashed phone — dropped during the struggle
strings.scene.photos[1].cap: The back corner of Midad Café
strings.scene.notes[0]: Two coffee cups — the victim welcomed someone she knew
strings.scene.notes[1]: The screen shows an unfinished line: evidence-nx
strings.scene.notes[2]: The backup drive is missing and the bag's zipper is torn
strings.evidence[0].title: The Second Cup
strings.evidence[0].desc: A complete fingerprint belonging to Nadim Azer, who swore he had not seen Dana for a week.
strings.evidence[1].title: The Unfinished Command
strings.evidence[1].desc: A final upload command for evidence-nx, the archive of evidence she had collected about her partner's leak.
strings.evidence[2].title: Git Log
strings.evidence[2].desc: evidence-nx was cloned at 01:12 from Nadim's device ID, after her death and before he fled.
strings.evidence[3].title: The Missing Drive
strings.evidence[3].desc: A complete copy of Nexa's code and deal files, the apparent target of the crime.
strings.evidence[4].title: The Investor's Messages
strings.evidence[4].desc: Mounting pressure to sign: "Say no tomorrow and you get nothing, Dana." An initial lead.
strings.evidence[5].title: The Rejection Memo
strings.evidence[5].desc: A letter rejecting the deal was ready to send in the morning, with a paragraph beginning: "Regarding my partner's actions…"
strings.suspects[0].name: Nadim Azer
strings.suspects[0].relation: Her partner since the company was founded
strings.suspects[0].alibi: "I was asleep in my apartment. I hadn't seen her for a week because of our dispute over the deal."
strings.suspects[0].statement: Dana was stubborn and would have burned the company down by refusing, but she was my sister on this journey. I haven't visited the café for a month. The early-morning clone? Our development machines synchronize automatically. Any programmer can explain that.
strings.suspects[1].name: Tarek Beik, the Investor
strings.suspects[1].alibi: "I had dinner with the buyers until one, then went to my hotel. The entrance is monitored."
strings.suspects[1].statement: I apply pressure because that's my job. Her rejection would kill the deal, but her death froze everything and cost me the commission of a lifetime. Whoever killed her also killed eight figures from my pocket.
strings.suspects[2].name: Karim, the Night Barista
strings.suspects[2].alibi: "I was behind the coffee machine the whole time, except for a ten-minute break to take out the trash."
strings.suspects[2].statement: Ms. Dana was our most valued customer. I learned the name of her drink before my own job title. During my break, I heard the doorbell; a visitor came in while I was out back. When I returned, the table was quiet… I thought she had fallen asleep from exhaustion, as she often did.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Closing Employee
strings.witnesses[0].statement: The second cup was still a little warm… and the back door was ajar, although we never open it at night.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Street Camera (Technical Record)
strings.witnesses[1].statement: A man in a dark coat entered through the front door at 00:45 and left through the back at 01:20, carrying something the size of a thick book: the backup drive in its case.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Nexa Developer
strings.witnesses[2].statement: Dana whispered to me last week: "If anything happens to me, open evidence-nx." I thought it was programmers' dark humor.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Café Incident Report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: The closing employee reported the incident. Responders found the computer open and documented the screen before touching anything.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Strangulation Report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Manual strangulation face to face across the table; signs of a brief struggle during which the phone fell.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Fingerprint Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: The fingerprint on the second cup is a complete match to the co-founder.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Partner Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: The "automatic synchronization" story was disproved technically: the clone required manual authentication with his personal key.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Investor Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: Dinner and the hotel are documented; no time gap allowed him to make the trip.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Barista Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: His break is confirmed by the rear-corridor camera. He returned minutes after the visitor entered.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: evidence-nx Log
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: The repository is a documented archive: messages from Nadim's account leaking the code to the acquiring company a month earlier in exchange for "special arrangements."
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Nadim's Apartment Entrance Log
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: Departure at 00:20 and return at 01:47 directly contradict his claim of uninterrupted sleep.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: The Complete Repository Contents
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: Dana quietly gathered evidence for three weeks and prepared to disclose it to the investors alongside her rejection. The murder silenced the meeting, not the truth.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Drive Recovery Record
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: The drive was in a cabinet in Nadim's office at the company itself. He had not even dared take it out of the building.
strings.reports[0].title: The 01:12 Report
strings.reports[0].author: Digital Crime Unit
strings.reports[0].body: Cloning the repository after her death using personal authentication places the killer in front of the very screen that left the unfinished line as a witness.
strings.reports[1].title: Acquisition Report
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: The killing was about silence, not the drive. Her explanation for rejecting the deal would have turned her partner from a founder into an accused leaker before the entire market.
strings.notes[0].text: Two cups = a visitor she knew… who denied being there?
strings.notes[1].text: Open evidence-nx — Dana's real last wish
